briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 push frontier capabilities as US-China export controls tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 major models this month with o4 and R2 leading capability jumps. Funding hit $15.2B in Q2 while regulatory pressure mounts on export controls and safety. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 2.1T parameters and multimodal reasoning. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek R2 matched o3 performance at 40% lower inference cost. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 400B.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New jailbreaks bypass three major providers. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: xAI activated 150k H200 cluster in Memphis. TSMC began 2nm AI chip volume production. Google and Microsoft announced $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips slow China's frontier progress more than they accelerate domestic alternatives?
